description: This file is an HTML document with embedded JavaScript used for a link insertion popup in a WYSIWYG editor (TinyMCE). It defines the user interface and scripting logic for inserting or editing hyperlinks within the editor.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the link dialog when loaded, called by tinyMCEPopup.

methods.name: insertLink
methods.description: Handles the insertion of the link into the editor when the form is submitted.
